name: Supplier quote comparison
summary: Collects supplier quote replies for one item list, logs each reply in a register, and drafts a side-by-side comparison for the buyer to check like for like. Crons read and draft; a person approves every chaser send and makes the award.

all.evidence: 3 manufacturing supplier quote calls read, 2 describe the process (metal fabrication, both by email, both quantities taken from drawings by hand)

covered_by.specify-item: skill (the item list and specs go into the comparison record)
covered_by.receive-quotes: intake (each reply logged to the register)
covered_by.compare-quotes: compare (side-by-side draft in the buyer's Drafts); the estimator reads and checks the prices

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Logs each new supplier quote reply to an open comparison in the register.

crons.name: compare
crons.summary: Drafts the side-by-side for the buyer whenever a comparison has quotes no draft covers yet.

crons.name: chase
crons.summary: Drafts chasers to suppliers who have not quoted when a chase is due, and queues each send for approval (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: an email in the buyer's Drafts, a row in the register, a read of the quote folder. Sending a chaser is a live operation and waits for a person.

microsoft-365.covers: quote replies read from the quote folder, comparison and chaser drafts, chaser sends queued for approval, Excel register rows

gaps: Odoo: the kit folder holds one docs-read operation (the version endpoint). Its purchase-requisition, RFQ and vendor pricing steps have no mapped operations, so no adapter is built for it.
Acumatica: the evidence names requisitions and RFQs, but the kit has no Acumatica platform folder, so no operations are mapped.
Like-for-like checks, price ranking, negotiation and the award are judgment steps for the agent skill and the estimator. The crons never parse or rank a price.
Writing the comparison record (the item list, the suppliers, the request date) into the store has no CLI command yet. The skill or a person writes it until one exists.
Chasing suppliers is not in the call evidence. The chase cron follows the same reply rules as the supplier RFQ workflow, so confirm with a buyer before it runs.
Turning an awarded quote into a purchase order is covered by the supplier RFQ workflow (manufacturing and all industries), not this one.
Takeoff from drawings is done by hand or by freelancers in the calls. The kit has no takeoff adapter.
The adapter is docs-only until a sandbox mailbox proves it.

evidence.platforms_in_kit: Odoo (docs read only, no RFQ or purchase order operations); Acumatica has no kit folder
evidence.platform_used: microsoft-365, because the calls say quotes come in by email and it is the mapped mail and register platform
